page.overview:
Who is Kel Algwinn?

Kel Algwinn was a male Human student at the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Jedi Civil War.

Sometime before Revan and his companions arrived on Korriban, Kel Algwinn had received a Sith Medallion from Yuthura Ban and joined the Sith Academy. His Sith Master berated him numerous times for being too trustworthy and too willing to show weakness. Although Algwinn considered himself weak, in actuality he was not as corrupted by the dark side as the other Sith hopefuls in the Academy. This caused him to have doubts about his place at the Academy. When the Jedi and former Sith Lord Revan infiltrated the Academy in his search for the Star Map on the planet, he attempted to persuade Kel to become a Jedi. Algwinn was conflicted by the different viewpoints presented to him, but before he could come to a decision, he was killed when the residents of the Academy attacked Revan after discovering that he was a spy for the Jedi.

Unlike other Sith hopefuls, Kel kindly greeted Revan when the two of them first met. He was doubtful about himself and his abilities and questioned if the Sith were really for him. Although he knew the Sith Code and could recite it by memory, he could never understand it. Kel's Sith Master told him many times that he was too trustworthy and too willing to show weakness.

Like other Sith hopefuls, Kel Algwinn wore a gray uniform. He used a single-bladed red lightsaber.
